  - **Why it matters:** New England’s passing game loses a key target for the rest of the game; status beyond that wasn’t specified.
  - **Watch next:** Any follow-up on severity or missed time.

- **Brock Bowers, Raiders TE**
  - **Underwent knee surgery** and is set to **miss Week 1 against the Dolphins**.
  - **Why it matters:** Las Vegas loses one of its top weapons early in the season.
  - **Watch next:** Timeline for return was **not specified**.

- **None specified today.**

HOU.summary:
- **Kayshon Boutte (WR)** — Houston’s first unofficial depth chart slots the newly acquired receiver as one of the three starting wideouts alongside Nico Collins and Xavier Hutchinson, with Jaylin Noel pushed outside that top group. That signals Boutte could be featured immediately in Week 1, while Noel’s early-slot share looks more limited than his camp buzz might have suggested. [1]

- **Marlin Klein (TE)** — The rookie tight end has climbed to TE3 behind Dalton Schultz and Foster Moreau, while Brevin Jordan’s knee issue has dropped him to TE5 on the depth chart. That points to a small but real early-season role for Klein, with the Texans seemingly willing to give him reps over Jordan but not yet over Schultz/Moreau. [1]

- **Texans pass rush / Bills matchup** — Will Anderson framed this as an “AFC Championship matchup” and emphasized Houston’s edge-duo edge against Josh Allen, who has struggled in Houston. For Week 1 projections, that keeps the Texans’ defense in play as a sack/upside unit and raises the chance the Bills’ offense is pressured into a less efficient script. [4, 8]
